concerns.text: FR-005 and SC-001 explicitly require a 'permutation test' p-value to be reported. Task T030c implements a 'paired t-test' against a null baseline. No task exists to implement the permutation test logic required by the spec, leaving SC-001 unmeasurable.

SC-004 requires a 'lineage report' proving the target variable (fidelity loss) independence from model scores. Task T014 generates a lineage report for 'primary_dimension' derivation only. No task exists to generate a specific lineage trace for the fidelity loss calculation (T024) verifying the MAE target did not incorporate teacher scores.

Task T042 requires verifying the permutation test uses 'at least 1000 permutations'. Since the permutation test implementation is missing from the task list (see FR-005/SC-001 gap), this review task has no code artifact to validate against, making the task an orphan.

Task T024b is tagged with [FR-003] but implements a 'Cross-Dimensional' variant (target = primary + 1). FR-003 defines 'dimensional fidelity loss' against the 'primary quality dimension' (same dimension). The tag [FR-003] on T024b is stale/incorrect as it describes a different hypothesis variant not defined in FR-003.
Task T039 appears twice: once in Phase 2 and once in Phase 6. The duplicate entry in Phase 6 is redundant and should be removed to avoid confusion.
